# Igor Panarin — living systems, built with AI

> Builder working alone with AI. Every project keeps its own living context — a set of plain files
> it reads at the start of a session, so work resumes instead of restarting. The catalogue at
> https://panarini.github.io shows what each project is, how it is built, and what was decided.

## Flagship: Teaching Companion
- Working now: lesson-plan engine — photo of a textbook page in, materials and lesson plan out
  (PPP/ESA/TPR/TBL). Demo being reworked.
- In the making: living memory (remembers the class and the teacher's style) and a body —
  a Reachy Mini robot.
- Horizon: an autonomous teaching creature; a companion, not a replacement.

## Catalogue
- Sound Focus — https://panarini.github.io/projects/sound-focus.html
  Focus timer with no digits on screen; time is made of sound, generated on the device.
  In the Chrome Web Store as "Minimalist Timer". The page shows how the tone is synthesised,
  what the panel looked like at each stage, and a dated log of decisions.
- Demand Telescope — https://panarini.github.io/projects/telescope.html
  Internal instrument turning search data into a navigable sky of demand: 1641 queries, of which
  630 are checked against real search results. Used to decide what to build next.
- Worksheet generator — https://panarini.github.io/projects/logoped.html
  Printable speech-therapy material assembled for one specific child: every word filtered against
  the sounds that child cannot say yet.
- ExportGPT — shipped Chrome extension: ChatGPT conversations to clean PDFs.
- The Garden — the method itself: living context per project, decisions kept as a log.
